Situations are decided on the server from recorded snapshot fields only. English only; reviewed by: pending (founder).

comfort.none: Nothing is done, so there is nothing to feel today.
comfort.numbed: Done with the tooth numbed. Some soreness afterwards is usual.
comfort.numbed_longer: Done with the area numbed over a few visits. Some soreness afterwards is usual.
comfort.surgical: Done with the area numbed. Swelling and soreness for a few days are usual, and we give you aftercare.

if_wait.words: The decay has reached the soft layer under the enamel and is close to the nerve.
It spreads to the nerve. The tooth often starts to ache, especially with hot or cold.
The nerve can die and the root can get infected. The tooth is then harder to save.

options.label: Wait and watch
options.summary: Leave it for now and look again at the next visit.
options.looks_like: Decay does not heal by itself. Waiting usually means it gets deeper and the tooth starts to ache.

options.label: Root canal and cap
options.summary: Clean the inside of the tooth, seal it, then cover it with a cap (crown).
options.looks_like: Your own tooth is kept, with a cap on top.

options.label: Remove the tooth, then an implant
options.summary: Take the tooth out, let the area heal, then place an implant and a crown on it.
options.looks_like: A new tooth on an implant fills the gap.

options.label: Remove the tooth, then a bridge
options.summary: Take the tooth out, then join a new tooth to the teeth either side of the gap.
options.looks_like: A new tooth held by the neighbouring teeth fills the gap.

options.label: Remove the tooth only
options.summary: Take the tooth out and leave the gap.
options.looks_like: A gap where the tooth was.

if_wait.words: The infection has reached the root of the tooth. It can cause pain or swelling.
The infection spreads in the bone around the root. Swelling and pain tend to come back.
It can spread to the face and the body. Treatment is then needed more urgently.

options.looks_like: Your own tooth is kept, with a cap on top.

if_wait.words: There is a gap where the tooth was.
The teeth next to the gap slowly lean in, and the tooth above or below can drift down or up.
Food gets trapped, chewing gets harder on that side, and the gap becomes harder to fill.

options.label: Implant
options.summary: A small post is placed in the jaw. Once it has healed, a crown goes on top.
options.looks_like: A new tooth that stands on its own.

options.label: Bridge
options.summary: A new tooth is joined to the teeth either side of the gap.
options.looks_like: A new tooth held by the neighbouring teeth.

options.label: Leave the gap
options.summary: Do nothing for now. We keep an eye on the neighbouring teeth.
options.looks_like: The gap stays, and the nearby teeth usually move into it over time.

impacted_wisdom.title: A wisdom tooth that is not fully out

if_wait.words: The tooth is only partly through the gum, or still under it.
Food and germs get under the gum flap. The gum around it can swell and hurt from time to time.
The tooth next to it can decay or be pushed, and the infection can come back again and again.

options.label: Remove it
options.summary: A small procedure to take the wisdom tooth out.
options.looks_like: The tooth is gone and the gum heals over.

options.label: Keep watching it
options.summary: Leave it for now and look at it again, usually with an X-ray.
options.looks_like: The tooth stays as it is for now. If it starts to hurt or swell, it usually needs to come out.
